files.README.md:
# Ironquay Freight - Ashford and Ellwood depots

employee_roster.csv lists the depot staff on the February 2026 payroll,
with the department each person is assigned to. hours_log_february_2026.csv
records the hours each person booked during February 2026, keyed by
employee id. Hours are decimal hours, and a person's hours count against
the department shown beside that person in the roster.
